issues.title: feat: manager login page (/[companySlug]/login)
issues.summary: Created the manager login page at app/[companySlug]/login/page.tsx with Firebase Auth email/password sign-in, company name display from Firestore, companySlug mismatch rejection, and cookie-based token persistence. Extended middleware.ts to protect 2-segment and /menu manager routes, excluding admin panel paths.
acceptance_criteria: Login page renders at /[companySlug]/login with correct company name
Valid manager login redirects to their branch panel
Manager logged into wrong company's URL is rejected and signed out
Non-manager role is rejected
Already-authenticated manager visiting login is redirected to their panel

issues.title: feat: Firestore schema and helpers for menu, categories, and items
issues.summary: Created lib/manager-menu.ts with TypeScript types (MenuConfig, Category, MenuItem, Customizations) and all Firestore client-side helpers: menu config read/write, real-time category/item subscriptions, full CRUD + reorder for categories and items. Updated firestore.rules to add items subcollection nested under categories.
acceptance_criteria: All TypeScript types defined
All helper functions implemented and tested with Firestore emulator
Security rules enforce manager-scoped writes
Price stored as integer cents throughout

issues.title: feat: manager basic panel dashboard (/[companySlug]/[branchSlug])
issues.summary: Built the manager dashboard page with auth guard (redirects non-managers), layout shell with sign-out and Menu nav link, branch details card with active QR count, real-time active sessions widget, and real-time incoming orders feed with Accept/Reject buttons.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard renders at /[companySlug]/[branchSlug] for authenticated managers
Branch details card shows correct info
Active sessions list updates in real-time
Incoming orders feed updates in real-time with accept/reject actions
"Create / Modify Menu" button navigates to menu editor
Sign out clears session and redirects to login

issues.title: feat: menu editor — category creation, inline editing, and drag-to-reorder
issues.summary: Created the menu editor page at app/[companySlug]/[branchSlug]/menu/page.tsx with publish/unpublish toggle, real-time category list via subscribeCategories, empty-state inline input, click-to-edit category names, delete with confirm, and HTML5 drag-to-reorder with optimistic updates calling reorderCategories.
acceptance_criteria: Empty state shows + Create a category prompt
Clicking prompt opens inline input and creates category on save
Existing category names are click-to-edit inline
+ button adds new category
Categories can be drag-to-reordered and order persists to Firestore
Publish/unpublish toggle updates Firestore and shows correct badge

issues.title: feat: menu editor — item creation and editing form (inline card)
issues.summary: Created CategoryItemsSection.tsx with real-time item subscription, ghost + card for empty state, item cards with image/name/price/dietary tags/availability toggle, and ItemForm.tsx slide-up modal with Firebase Storage image upload, all item fields (name, description, price, dietary tags, allergen note, size/add-on customizations, special instructions toggle), and save/discard actions.
acceptance_criteria: Empty category shows ghost card with +
Clicking ghost card opens item form
Image upload to Firebase Storage works with progress indicator
All fields (name, description, price, tags, allergen, customizations) are editable
Save validates name and price; Discard closes without saving
Existing items open pre-populated form on click
Availability toggle saves immediately to Firestore

issues.title: feat: menu editor — item drag-to-reorder within categories
issues.summary: Enhanced CategoryItemsSection.tsx with HTML5 drag-to-reorder for items: GripVertical drag handle on each card, optimistic local reorder on drop with reorderItems() Firestore persistence, opacity-50 on dragged card and ring-2 ring-blue-400 on drop target. Ghost + card excluded from drag handlers.
acceptance_criteria: Items within a category can be reordered by dragging
Drag handle visible on each item card
Order persists to Firestore via reorderItems() on drop
Visual drag preview shows while dragging

issues.title: feat: real-time cart cleanup when manager deletes a menu item mid-session
issues.summary: Enhanced deleteItem() in manager-menu.ts to batch-remove deleted items from all active session baskets (chunked in 499-write batches). Added RemovedItemsToast hook and session-context detection that suppresses echoes of local writes, triggering a toast pill when items are externally removed from a basket.
acceptance_criteria: Deleting a menu item removes it from all active session carts in the same Firestore batch
Public cart UI reflects the removal in real-time without a page reload
Public user sees a notification that item(s) were removed

issues.title: feat: public user — optional email capture and post-payment order persistence
issues.summary: Added optional email field to UserBasket type and AddToCartSheet identity step. Created POST /api/orders route using Admin SDK to write confirmed orders to top-level orders collection with status: pending. CheckoutSheet fires the API call non-fatally on view === confirmed. Added orders Firestore security rule (manager/superadmin read, Admin SDK write only).
acceptance_criteria: Identity form shows optional email field
Email is stored in session identity alongside name and phone
After payment confirmation, order is written to orders collection with full item details and user identity
Orders are queryable by companyId + branchId for future analytics

issues.title: feat: public QR route — show 'menu not yet available' when menu is unpublished
issues.summary: Added isMenuPublished() server-side helper to lib/menu.ts using adminDb. Updated the [...path] catch-all page to check publish status before rendering MenuPage — returns the new MenuNotAvailable component (friendly message, no cart/session) if unpublished or config missing.
acceptance_criteria: Scanning a QR for an unpublished menu shows 'Menu not yet available' page
No session is created for unpublished menus
Published menus continue to work as before
Check is server-side (no flash of empty menu)
